00001| -- =====================================================
00002| -- VENUES DATABASE SCHEMA FOR GOOGLE PLACES API CACHING
00003| -- =====================================================
00004| -- Run this script in your Supabase SQL Editor to create venue tables
00005| 
00006| -- Create venues table for caching Google Places data
00007| CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.venues (
00008|     id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
00009|     place_id TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, -- Google Places ID
00010|     name TEXT NOT NULL,
00011|     address TEXT NOT NULL,
00012|     formatted_address TEXT,
00013|     phone TEXT,
00014|     website TEXT,
00015|     rating DECIMAL(2,1),
00016|     reviews_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
00017|     price_level INTEGER, -- 0-4 from Google Places
00018|     category TEXT NOT NULL, -- indoor, outdoor, specialty, community
00019|     types TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[], -- Google Places types
00020|     business_status TEXT, -- OPERATIONAL, CLOSED_TEMPORARILY, etc.
00021|     
00022|     -- Location data
00023|     latitude DECIMAL(10, 8),
00024|     longitude DECIMAL(11, 8),
00025|     zip_code TEXT,
00026|     city TEXT,
00027|     state TEXT,
00028|     country TEXT DEFAULT 'US',
00029|     
00030|     -- Additional venue details
00031|     description TEXT,
00032|     photos TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[], -- Photo references from Google Places
00033|     opening_hours JSONB, -- Store opening hours as JSON
00034|     accessibility_info TEXT,
00035|     parking_info TEXT,
00036|     
00037|     -- Party-specific information
00038|     party_packages_available BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
00039|     max_capacity INTEGER,
00040|     age_restrictions TEXT,
00041|     amenities TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
00042|     
00043|     -- Caching and validation
00044|     last_validated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00045|     data_freshness_days INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
00046|     is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
00047|     
00048|     -- Metadata
00049|     created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00050|     updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW()
00051| );
00052| 
00053| -- Create venue searches table for caching search results
00054| CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.venue_searches (
00055|     id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
00056|     zip_code TEXT NOT NULL,
00057|     category TEXT NOT NULL,
00058|     radius_miles INTEGER DEFAULT 20,
00059|     search_query TEXT, -- Optional search term
00060|     min_rating DECIMAL(2,1) DEFAULT 0,
00061|     
00062|     -- Results metadata
00063|     total_results INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
00064|     search_completed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00065|     expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days'),
00066|     
00067|     -- Metadata
00068|     created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00069|     
00070|     UNIQUE(zip_code, category, radius_miles, search_query, min_rating)
00071| );
00072| 
00073| -- Create venue search results junction table
00074| CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.venue_search_results (
00075|     id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
00076|     search_id UUID REFERENCES public.venue_searches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
00077|     venue_id UUID REFERENCES public.venues(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
00078|     distance_miles DECIMAL(5,2),
00079|     search_rank INTEGER, -- Order in search results
00080|     
00081|     created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00082|     
00083|     UNIQUE(search_id, venue_id)
00084| );
00085| 
00086| -- Create selected venues table to track party venue selections
00087| CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.party_venues (
00088|     id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() PRIMARY KEY,
00089|     party_id UUID REFERENCES public.parties(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
00090|     venue_id UUID REFERENCES public.venues(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
00091|     user_id UUID REFERENCES public.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE NOT NULL,
00092|     
00093|     -- Custom venue details (for home venues or custom entries)
00094|     custom_name TEXT,
00095|     custom_address TEXT,
00096|     custom_notes TEXT,
00097|     
00098|     -- Selection details
00099|     selected_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00100|     is_custom BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, -- TRUE for home/custom venues
00101|     
00102|     created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00103|     updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT NOW(),
00104|     
00105|     UNIQUE(party_id) -- Each party can only have one venue
00106| );
00107| 
00108| -- Create indexes for better performance
00109| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_place_id ON public.venues(place_id);
00110| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_category ON public.venues(category);
00111| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_zip_code ON public.venues(zip_code);
00112| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_rating ON public.venues(rating);
00113| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_location ON public.venues(latitude, longitude);
00114| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venues_last_validated ON public.venues(last_validated_at);
00115| 
00116| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venue_searches_zip_category ON public.venue_searches(zip_code, category);
00117| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venue_searches_expires ON public.venue_searches(expires_at);
00118| 
00119| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venue_search_results_search ON public.venue_search_results(search_id);
00120| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_venue_search_results_venue ON public.venue_search_results(venue_id);
00121| 
00122| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_party_venues_party ON public.party_venues(party_id);
00123| CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_party_venues_venue ON public.party_venues(venue_id);
00124| 
00125| -- Enable Row Level Security
00126| ALTER TABLE public.venues ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
00127| ALTER TABLE public.venue_searches ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
00128| ALTER TABLE public.venue_search_results ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
00129| ALTER TABLE public.party_venues ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
00130| 
00131| -- Create RLS policies for venues (public read access for venue data)
00132| CREATE POLICY "Venues are viewable by everyone" ON public.venues FOR SELECT USING (true);
00133| CREATE POLICY "Only system can insert venues" ON public.venues FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (false); -- Will be handled by service role
00134| 
00135| -- Create RLS policies for venue searches (public read access)
00136| CREATE POLICY "Venue searches are viewable by everyone" ON public.venue_searches FOR SELECT USING (true);
00137| CREATE POLICY "Anyone can create venue searches" ON public.venue_searches FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
00138| 
00139| -- Create RLS policies for venue search results (public read access)
00140| CREATE POLICY "Venue search results are viewable by everyone" ON public.venue_search_results FOR SELECT USING (true);
00141| CREATE POLICY "Anyone can create venue search results" ON public.venue_search_results FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (true);
00142| 
00143| -- Create RLS policies for party venues (user can only access their own)
00144| CREATE POLICY "Users can view their own party venues" ON public.party_venues FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
00145| CREATE POLICY "Users can insert their own party venues" ON public.party_venues FOR INSERT WITH CHECK (auth.uid() = user_id);
00146| CREATE POLICY "Users can update their own party venues" ON public.party_venues FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
00147| CREATE POLICY "Users can delete their own party venues" ON public.party_venues FOR DELETE USING (auth.uid() = user_id);
00148| 
00149| -- Create update trigger for venues
00150| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_venues_updated_at()
00151| RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
00152| BEGIN
00153|     NEW.updated_at = NOW();
00154|     RETURN NEW;
00155| END;
00156| $$ language plpgsql;
00157| 
00158| CREATE TRIGGER venues_updated_at
00159|     BEFORE UPDATE ON public.venues
00160|     FOR EACH ROW
00161|     EXECUTE FUNCTION update_venues_updated_at();
00162| 
00163| -- Create update trigger for party venues
00164| CREATE TRIGGER party_venues_updated_at
00165|     BEFORE UPDATE ON public.party_venues
00166|     FOR EACH ROW
00167|     EXECUTE FUNCTION update_venues_updated_at();
00168| 
00169| -- Create function to clean expired venue searches
00170| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION cleanup_expired_venue_searches()
00171| RETURNS void AS $$
00172| BEGIN
00173|     DELETE FROM public.venue_searches WHERE expires_at < NOW();
00174| END;
00175| $$ language plpgsql;
00176| 
00177| -- Create function to refresh stale venue data
00178| CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_stale_venues()
00179| RETURNS void AS $$
00180| BEGIN
00181|     UPDATE public.venues 
00182|     SET is_active = false 
00183|     WHERE last_validated_at < (NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days');
00184| END;
00185| $$ language plpgsql;
00186| 
00187| COMMENT ON TABLE public.venues IS 'Cached venue data from Google Places API';
00188| COMMENT ON TABLE public.venue_searches IS 'Cached search queries and metadata';
00189| COMMENT ON TABLE public.venue_search_results IS 'Junction table linking searches to venue results';
00190| COMMENT ON TABLE public.party_venues IS 'Selected venues for specific parties';
</file>
